parts.name: Shader converter: instruction forms
parts.note: Counts and shares are in the figures above.

parts.name: Shader converter: control flow
parts.note: Uniform branches, loops and exec-mask divergence (skip branches, discard, divergent loops) work; the remaining branch shapes are not done.

parts.name: Shader converter: stages
parts.note: Pixel, vertex and compute draw on a real GPU. Geometry (NGG ES+GS to VS+GS) and tessellation (LS+HS to VS+HS, TES to DS) translate; fractional_odd tessellation is refused. Mesh shaders are not started.

parts.name: GPU memory access
parts.note: Buffer, global, image and typed loads and stores, LDS and barriers, 32-bit atomics, raw T#/S#/V# descriptors from heap memory and a gfx10 detiler work. Float and 64-bit atomics are refused.

parts.name: Console Direct3D 12 layer
parts.note: Console D3D12 over desktop D3D12: Device1-10, CommandList1-7, ExecuteIndirect, enhanced barriers, title GPU addresses. Console device creation works, and console queues, allocators, placed buffers, page pools, descriptor heaps at title addresses, views, samplers and command signatures are adapted. Console pipeline streams get stand-in pipelines until console shaders are wired in.

parts.name: Runtime and system libraries
parts.note: Game-runtime gateway (QueryApiImpl) with task queues, async, user, saves, packages and system; XMem memory layer (physical pages, placeholders, scatter mapping); paths, threading, timing, GameInput, XAudio2 and our own DirectStorage; an XG texture-layout stand-in (linear layouts). Console audio hardware DLLs run silent.

parts.name: Native launcher
parts.note: Maps a program, resolves imports through shims, the package, Windows or logged stubs; implicit TLS, module identity, C++ exceptions and dynamic lookups work. Every run log ends with a summary, with stack traces on asserts and crashes; names and paths are redacted.

parts.name: Runtime milestone ladder
parts.note: R1 to R5 reached: report and launch, clear/present, translated triangle, textures and depth, compute and a 600-frame loop. Next is R6, a real title.

parts.name: CPU patch layer
parts.note: Zen 2 instructions a host CPU lacks (SHA, CLWB, RDPID, SSE4a, MWAITX, CLZERO, RDPRU) are trapped and handled.

parts.name: Running a title
parts.note: Microsoft GDK PC samples run on our runtime. A permitted Xbox Series test title boots through device creation, memory setup, file streaming and its first textures for about 4 seconds, then stops in display setup; it does not render yet.
